en.title: When an opening into the sinus forms after a tooth comes out

sentences.text: This is the right upper jaw, cut through the big back tooth.
Above the roots is the sinus, an air space in the cheekbone.
In some people, the roots reach up into the sinus.
Taking out such a tooth can leave a hole into the sinus (an OAC).
sentences.tts: Taking out such a tooth can leave a hole into the sinus, an O A C.

sentences.text: If it stays open, a lining grows inside, and it becomes a lasting tunnel (an OAF).
sentences.tts: If it stays open, a lining grows inside, and it becomes a lasting tunnel, an O A F.

sentences.text: A small hole may heal by itself under a blood clot.
Bigger holes are closed with a flap of gum.
If drinks come out of your nose after an upper tooth comes out, contact your dentist.
